csv_scope_of_work: The City of Chardon is requesting qualifications for general engineering services for the calendar year 2026. Qualifications shall be submitted for engineering services which include investigations, studies, design, construction administration, inspection services, and maintenance of the following: Roadway, traffic, and signalization Storm sewer, drainage, and stormwater/watershed management Waterline, distribution, and treatment Sanitary sewer, collection, and treatment

title: As-Needed 2026 General Engineering Services
short_description: On-call municipal engineering services for roads, utilities, drainage, and construction administration in Chardon.
project_scope: On-call general engineering services for calendar year 2026 covering municipal infrastructure: roadway, traffic and signalization; storm sewer, drainage and stormwater/watershed management; waterline distribution and treatment; sanitary sewer collection and treatment. Services may include investigations, studies, design, construction administration, inspection, and maintenance support.
services: General engineering services including investigations, studies, design, construction administration, inspection services, and maintenance support across transportation and utility disciplines.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a broad on-call municipal engineering services solicitation, not a defined bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure project.
- Scope is dominated by roads, traffic, drainage, water, and sanitary infrastructure rather than structurally demanding load-bearing systems.
- No specific structural complexity, span, innovative material use, or architectural ambition is indicated.
- It resembles a general framework/as-needed services contract without a clear technical focus relevant to sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for as-needed engineering services for multiple possible municipal infrastructure tasks over 2026, so no realistic single project construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. This is an on-call qualifications-based solicitation with ongoing submissions and unspecified task orders, so no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualifications requested for general engineering services across all disciplines. Specific minimum reference requirements are not stated in the provided notice.
award_criteria: Qualifications-based selection implied by RFQ/RFP for general engineering services; specific award criteria or weighting are not stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: City of Chardon, Chardon, Ohio, USA. Contact: Justin A. Czekaj, P.E. Phone: 440-286-2600. Fax: 440-286-2658. Email: publicsrv@cityofchardon.gov. Website: https://www.cityofchardon.gov/bids.aspx?bidID=3
notes: Submissions are accepted on an ongoing basis; no deadline set. Contract duration is 12 months, renewable: no. Target market is Streets/Highways. Although categorized here as Road Bridges to fit the required schema, the notice is actually a general municipal engineering services solicitation and not specifically a bridge project.
